Cockos Loudness Meter reference

Copyright (C) 2021 and later Cockos Incorporated

The Native Meter implementation uses REAPER's
analysis/loudness_meter JSFX as the behavioral and algorithmic reference
for compatibility with Cockos' official loudness meter.

The implementation is written in C++ and adapted to ReaWebAPI's native
meter architecture. Portions that are derived from the Cockos JSFX are
distributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License.

The original JSFX states:
  This effect Copyright (C) 2021 and later Cockos Incorporated
  License: LGPL - http://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl.html

COPYING.LESSER and COPYING are included with the project.

Other loudness analysis may use libebur128. See libebur128.txt for its
copyright and license notice.
